alex_support: Customer reports 413 'Payload Too Large' from /v1/rerank. They say query is ~1200 chars, docs array length 230 items, each doc avg 400 chars. Repro below.

kenji_infra: Can you paste the exact curl + body? Also which model? Rerank has combined token ceilings per request.

alex_support: Here's curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwrk-rl-1","query":"...", "docs":[{"id":"1","text":"..."}, ...] }'
```
They used `rwrk-rl-1` and got 413. Error body returned: `{"error":"413 payload too large: input token limit exceeded"}` — customer says message is ambiguous.

maria_prod: Important: our rerank service enforces a combined token limit (query + all docs) and we also have soft per-doc thresholds that trigger earlier. If docs count is large it's easy to exceed the budget even if each doc seems small.

sophie_docs: Suggestion for support reply: explain token budget, show how to approximate tokens (use 4 chars ≈ 1 token), and include a chunking example. Eg: query 1200 chars ≈ 300 tokens; 230 docs × 400 chars ≈ 92k chars ≈ 23k tokens → way over typical budgets.

alex_support: I'm drafting the customer reply. They asked for a minimal code fix. Proposed approaches: 1) pre-filter with embeddings to top-K, 2) truncate each doc to 1-2 passages before calling rerank, 3) split into multiple rerank calls and merge scores.

kenji_infra: For our internal repro: try incremental doc counts to find the threshold. Also confirm whether the customer hit 413 consistently or only for that specific batch. Add logs (request id) so we can check token accounting.

alex_support: Customer tried smaller runs: at docs=50 they get 200 OK, docs=120 they hit 413 consistently. So threshold sits around 100-130 depending on doc size. They provided request-id: rq_7f3b2e.

maria_prod: Ops note: error message should be clearer and actionable. Filed internal ticket INF-842 to update the 413 payload message to include: approximate token budget, example fixes (chunking/embeddings/top-K), and a link to KB. Until then, ask customers for sample payload sizes and request-id.

sophie_docs: I'll paste a short snippet we can send to customers:
```text
Quick fixes:
1) Pre-filter by embeddings/similarity and rerank top 50 results.
2) Truncate each doc to the first ~512 chars or split into passages.
3) If you must rerank >100 docs, page the requests (e.g., 100 docs per request) and merge results client-side.
Token estimate: total_chars / 4 ≈ tokens. Aim < 6,000 tokens for this model.
```

alex_support: Thanks — sending this now. Will include request-id and ask them to try a reduced batch and paste response headers. cc @kenji_infra for logs if we need escalation. :white_check_mark:

support_bot: Incident note created: INF-842 (rerank limit message improvement) — assigned to @maria_prod.
